description: Fork of exp513 (qk hard-argmax nap=4/tph=256 = 1.4825, the qk-sweep winner). ONLY change: ADD the shallow additive v-branch back -- qk_lut now emits 2*d_qk + d_v (q,k + last d_v added to v_lut), restoring the exp507/exp428 shared-anchor v-branch BUT from a HARD argmax qk (exp507/508's was soft, magnitude-leaking). v_tph kept at 320 (so v gets both the extra tables AND the branch -> small +0.4M qk params, not capacity-matched). Tests whether a hard shared-anchor v-branch helps on top of the best matmul-free qk. vs exp513 1.4825 (no branch), exp508 1.4840 (soft qk, soft branch removed).
